title: Ease of use, attractive design and compact size make this Bodum grinder an attractive addition to any kitchen
text:
Ease of use, attractive design and compact size make this Bodum grinder an attractive addition to any kitchen. Being a coffee lover, I prefer to grind my coffee beans immediately before brewing my coffee. This Bodum bistro blade grinder is the third grinder I have used in my kitchen. It is very basic, yet stylish. One of the design elements liked and appreciated are the raised dot area which ensures a slipproof grip. Another nice feature is the recess at the bottom of the grinder which allows the cord to be stored and out of the way.

This is a very basic unit but it gets the job done with a minimum of fuss. There are no additional settings so it is a good unit for the "grinding impaired". The lid is transparent so you have a visual of the grind and can determine the fineness at a glance. All you need to do is press down (a maximum of 60 seconds at a time) on the push-button control until you have the desired grind for your type of brewing. I use a drip-style pot so can't comment on the consistency and quality of espresso grind.

I would like to point out that I did encounter a minor problem when using the grinder for the first time. After grinding the beans, I emptied the ground coffee into the transparent cap where some of the "coffee dust" settled under the push-button control. This prevented the control from working. Once I figured out the problem, I simply removed the powdery residue and everything worked fine.

From my experience with blade coffee grinders, they all operate on the same basis with good results. The ease of use, attractive design and compact size of this Bodum make it an attractive addition to any kitchen.

product_metadata.title: Bodum BISTRO Blade Grinder, Electric Blade Coffee Grinder, Black
features: COFFEE GRINDER: BISTRO Blade coffee grinders take whole coffee beans from coarse to fine quickly and efficiently; fresh brewing from the comfort of your home
BLADE & MOTOR: The blade grinder has a strong, durable stainless steel cutting blade that spins at a precise RPM, plus a powerful 150W motor
SLEEK DESIGN: Push-button control allows for pulse action or continuous grind, and transparent lid allows the fineness grade to be observed to ensure coffee is made to your liking
COMPACT: Small coffee grinder has convenient cord storage in the base of grinder, perfect if you plan to leave out on the kitchen counter
SERVINGS: This powerful coffee grinder makes enough coffee needed for brewing 8 cups of French press; pair with Bodum coffee maker
description: The Bistro blade grinder is equipped with a powerful motor that allows the stainless steel blade to cut the Coffee beans quickly and efficiently, resulting in flavorful ground Coffee. The transparent lid allows users to see the coarseness of the Coffee while grinding, as the longer the grinding time the finer the resultant ground Coffee. Ideal for using in 60 second intervals, users can grind just enough Coffee needed for brewing 8 Cups in a Bodum press at the simple touch of a button. The Bistro blade grinder can also be used to grind spices. Available in black, red, and white.；The product voltage arrange is 110V
